Every entry below is the docstring of the installed package, printed at render time, so this
page is as current as the version the site was rendered against (shown on the
[Julia page](index.qmd)).

```{julia}
#| echo: false
using ConvolutionInterpolations, Markdown

# Print a binding's docstring as Markdown, with its headings demoted below the page's own
function docstring(name; only_first = false)
    md = Base.Docs.doc(name)                                   # every docstring of the binding
    only_first && (md = Markdown.MD(md.content[1:1]))          # for a type: the struct's own, not its call methods
    out = IOBuffer()                                           # the demoted Markdown is collected here
    in_fence = false                                           # whether the current line is inside a code block
    for line in eachline(IOBuffer(Markdown.plain(md)))
        startswith(line, "```") && (in_fence = !in_fence)      # a fence line opens or closes a code block
        if !in_fence && occursin(r"^#+ ", line)                # a heading outside code blocks
            line = "###" * line                                # "# Arguments" becomes "#### Arguments"
        end
        println(out, line)
    end
    println(String(take!(out)))
end;
```
